comments: Tommy returns after four weeks away and says the weather in London is as good as Ibiza where he was last week.
Ian Gillan apparently gave Tommy the version of 'If You Believe Me' which features on the Metal Explosion LP as a demo.
Tommy offers twenty five listeners the chance to appear in a video being shot by Heavy Pettin' at the Astoria in two weeks' time.
